subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should authenticated hook callers be allowed to re-enter durable session transcripts through an explicit persistent mode, and under which agent and session-key prefix constraints?
rationale: The requested capability intentionally changes the hook isolation boundary; source inspection proves the functional gap, but only maintainers can approve durable cross-request transcript access.

options.title: Approve explicit persistent mode
options.body: Keep isolated as the default and allow persistent reuse only through an explicit mode with effective-agent, request-session-key, and prefix policy enforcement.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated
options.body: Reject durable transcript re-entry and update the public contract to state that hook-agent runs do not retain prior transcript context.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit persistent mode
recommendation.body: Keep isolated as the default and allow persistent reuse only through an explicit mode with effective-agent, request-session-key, and prefix policy enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the relevant session-key security hardening and has already articulated the preferred backward-compatible shape in this issue.
